# GJ Premium

> GJ Premium is a medical supply company. It supplies clinics, medical
> practices, laboratories, pharmacies and care facilities with everyday
> patient-care consumables across ten product categories, and returns a
> written quote (pricing, availability and delivery window) within one
> business day. Orders are requested through a single public form; no
> account is required.

The company's contact details: gjpremium14@gmail.com · +44 7485 206665 ·
Monday to Friday, 08:00–18:00 ET.

## Product categories

Ten categories are supplied: Wound care, Diabetes care, Infusion & vascular
access, Medical nutrition, Continence drainage, Incontinence absorbing,
Nursing & facilities, Personal care, Personal protection, and Surgical & OR.

## Optional

- [Full category list with typical line items](https://gjpremium.com/products): every category, what it covers, and example items.
- [Request a quote](https://gjpremium.com/quote): the single form used to request pricing; fields are contact, facility, items and quantities, delivery location and needed-by date.
- [Privacy policy](https://gjpremium.com/privacy): how request data is stored, used and retained.
